model.title: Model
model.description: The LiteLLM model name to use, e.g. claude-sonnet, gpt-4o, or local.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional instructions that set how the assistant should behave.

user_prompt.title: User Prompt
user_prompt.description: The user's message. Provide this (the simple case), or use Messages for a full multi-turn conversation.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Advanced: a full chat history. When provided, this overrides System Prompt and User Prompt.

role.title: Role
role.description: One of: system, user, assistant, tool.

content.title: Content
content.description: The message text. May be empty on an assistant message that only requests tools.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional. On a tool-result message, the name of the tool/function that produced it.

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call ID
tool_call_id.description: Optional. On a tool-result message, the id of the assistant tool call it answers.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: Optional. On an assistant message, the tool calls it requested — pass back verbatim from a previous reply's Tool Calls output to continue the conversation.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: 0 = focused and deterministic, higher = more creative. Leave blank for the model default.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the reply.

json_response.title: JSON Response
json_response.description: When true, asks the model to return a strict JSON object (use when your prompt requests JSON). The reply is also parsed into the JSON output.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Advanced: a raw OpenAI response_format object, e.g. {"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{...}}. Overrides JSON Response when set.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Advanced: a list of tool/function definitions in OpenAI format, e.g. [{"type":"function","function":{"name":...,"description":...,"parameters":{...}}}]. When the model decides to use one, the Tool Calls output is populated and Finish Reason is "tool_calls".

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description: Advanced: how the model selects tools — "auto" (default), "none", or "required". Only applies when Tools is set.
